contexts.text: [Such were those Spirits] who formerly killed whole armies... by suddenly rushing into the chambers of the brain, and inspiring such terror that they slew one another... It is very rare at the present day that the bonds are loosened to any of them: only when anyone is such that it is better that he should be permitted to perish as to the body than as to the soul; and who, unless he perished as to the body in such a manner by insanities and suicide, could not but perish to eternity. (See AC 5717.)
